mission: Mission 8 — Experiment G: Temporal Detection Consistency
finding: Temporal consistency tracking requires continuous multi-frame sequences with persistent object tracks. Because BDD100K detection data contains isolated keyframes with 92.5%-97.0% singleton video distribution, track-level IoU consistency and false-positive persistence cannot be evaluated on Group B/C without violating the non-negotiable instruction against data fabrication. Algorithm is verified in unit tests.
tracker_architecture: TemporalConsistencyTracker (IoU matching + EMA confidence momentum + min-hits gating)
